records.command: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$env:USERPROFILE/.codex/models_cache.json") { node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.USERPROFILE+"/.codex/models_cache.json")); console.log(Object.keys(r)); for(const m of r.models||[]) if(/gpt-(6.1|5.6)-sol/.test(m.slug||m.id||"")) console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m).filter(([key])=>/slug|id|tool|plan|mode/.test(key)))));' }
